sloka: अपधिर्न मया कार्य्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सित: ।युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम् ॥ २.१११.२९॥
transliteration: apadhirna mayā kāryyo vanavāse jugupsita: ।yuktamuktaṁ ca kaikeyyā pitrā me sukṛtaṁ kṛtam ॥ 2.111.29॥

translations.english: As far as living in the forest is concerned it is reprehensible to keep a subsitute for me and it shall not be done. Kaikeyi has acted rightfully and my father has taken the proper decision.
